question: ts-food-service 的 REST 下游服务和 MQ 下游服务如何组合？
reference_cypher: MATCH (m:方法)-[:归属于]->(:类)-[:归属于]->(s:微服务) MATCH (m)-[:下游调用]->(d:下游API)-[:目标服务]->(t:微服务) WHERE s.服务名称=$source AND ($target IS NULL OR t.服务名称=$target) RETURN DISTINCT t.服务名称 AS rest_service,d.API路径 AS rest_path ORDER BY rest_service,rest_path LIMIT 5001
MATCH (s:微服务)-[:消息依赖]->(t:微服务) WHERE s.服务名称=$source RETURN DISTINCT t.服务名称 AS mq_service ORDER BY mq_service LIMIT 5001

MATCH (p:方法)-[:归属于]->(:类)-[:归属于]->(s:微服务) MATCH (p)-[pub:发布至]->(:消息交换机)-[route:路由至]->(:消息队列)-[:消费自]->(c:方法) MATCH (c)-[:归属于]->(:类)-[:归属于]->(t:微服务) WHERE s.服务名称=$source AND pub.路由键 IS NOT NULL AND pub.路由键=route.路由键 RETURN DISTINCT t.服务名称 AS mq_service ORDER BY mq_service LIMIT 5001
reference_scope: REST 目标 × (服务级 MQ 依赖 ∪ 路由键匹配的闭合发布到消费目标)
